description: Four broad English-language weekly searches cover 1–28 February, but search-engine results are selective and do not establish that all local reports or gatherings were found.

description: Delfi/Postimees site-restricted queries produced no usable contemporary body evidence in the captured search layer. No systematic archive or LexisNexis access was available. Search non-results are not evidence that no qualifying events occurred.

description: The 23 January Tallinn Navalny demonstration is before the unit month. Search results do not establish an event continuing into February or an ending date.
